name: reschedule_appointment
description: MUST call immediately after the caller explicitly confirms a fresh replacement slot. Use exactly six values: appointment_id from list_appointments, caller_full_name from lookup_patient, plus practitioner_id, branch_id, appointment_type_id, and start_time copied unchanged from the confirmed search_availability slot. Never report a technical issue or create a follow-up unless this tool was actually called and returned ok=false. Mention a fee only when cancellation_fee.applicable is true.

appointment_id.description: Exact appointments[].id UUID from list_appointments for the appointment being moved.

practitioner_id.description: Exact practitioner_id from the confirmed replacement slot.

branch_id.description: Exact branch_id from the confirmed replacement slot.

appointment_type_id.description: Exact appointment_type_id from the confirmed replacement slot.

start_time.description: Exact start_time from the confirmed replacement slot; do not derive it from spoken time.
